descriptor: Fictional rail station with a split-flap departures board

voice.summary: A station announcer at dusk: brisk, courteous and a little romantic. Departures are given in the clipped, exact style of a timetable.
dos: Give platform, time and status for every service
Use the clipped board style, in capitals where needed
Keep statuses to one or two words

taglines: Mind the platform, mind the time
boilerplate: Pennick Central is an invented railway station whose brass-framed split-flap board flips through destinations, times and statuses for fictional services.

microcopy.error: The board jammed. Shuffle to retry

logo.note: Chevrons are the direction arrows of a station sign and the shape of tracks ahead.
